_about: Corridor descriptions and buyer due-diligence checks, rewritten 2026-10-21 to state only verifiable facts. Applied to existing rows by scripts/reference/sync-infra.ts.

corridorDescriptions.adibatla: South-east of the city beyond the ORR, around Adibatla, where TCS and Tata's aerospace units operate. Close to the ORR at Bongloor.
corridorDescriptions.bibinagar-bhongir: East along the Hyderabad–Warangal highway (NH-163), around AIIMS Bibinagar and Bhongir town.
corridorDescriptions.ghatkesar-peerzadiguda: East Hyderabad along the Warangal highway, near the Infosys campus and IT SEZ at Pocharam.
corridorDescriptions.kadthal-fcda: South along the Srisailam highway, at the edge of the Bharat Future City area around Mucherla (Future City Development Authority, set up in 2025).
corridorDescriptions.kokapet-neopolis: West Hyderabad next to the Financial District and the ORR, where HMDA auctioned the Neopolis layout. Mostly high-rise apartments.
corridorDescriptions.kompally-bachupally: North Hyderabad along NH-44 (Kompally) and towards Bachupally — a mature residential belt of apartments and gated communities.
corridorDescriptions.maheshwaram-pharma-city: South of the airport around Maheshwaram, near the E-City electronics cluster, with the Pharma City / Future City lands to the east.
corridorDescriptions.medchal-dundigal: North along NH-44 around Medchal and Dundigal — industrial estates, warehousing and growing residential layouts.
corridorDescriptions.sangareddy-industrial: North-west along NH-65 around Sangareddy and Kandi, home to IIT Hyderabad and older industrial estates. The RRR northern part passes here.
corridorDescriptions.shadnagar: South-west along the Hyderabad–Bengaluru highway (NH-44) around Shadnagar town and its industrial estates; a long-established plotting market.
corridorDescriptions.shankarpally-mokila: West beyond the ORR around Mokila and Shankarpally — mostly villa and plotted layouts, at lower density than the IT core.
corridorDescriptions.tukkuguda-shamshabad: South around Shamshabad and Tukkuguda, next to Rajiv Gandhi International Airport and the Fab City / hardware park area.

cmsvbeciy001g7m8o7kb696g0.title: Prohibited land (Section 22-A list)
cmsvbeciy001g7m8o7kb696g0.description: Section 22-A of the Registration Act bars registration of listed prohibited properties — government, assigned, endowment, Wakf and ceiling-surplus land. A plot on that list can't be legally sold to you.
cmsvbeciy001g7m8o7kb696g0.checkMethod: Search the survey number and village in the prohibited-properties list on the Bhu Bharati portal (which replaced Dharani in 2025), and ask the Sub-Registrar's office before paying an advance.
cmsvbeciy001g7m8o7kb696g0.govReference: Registration Act, 1908 — Section 22-A (as applied in Telangana)

cmsvbecj0001h7m8o4pjyh0bd.title: Lake FTL and buffer zones
cmsvbecj0001h7m8o4pjyh0bd.description: Building is not allowed inside a lake's Full Tank Level (FTL) or its buffer zone. HYDRAA, set up in 2024, has demolished structures built in these zones.
cmsvbecj0001h7m8o4pjyh0bd.checkMethod: Ask for the irrigation department's FTL/buffer certificate for the survey number and compare the layout plan with HMDA's lake boundary maps.
cmsvbecj0001h7m8o4pjyh0bd.govReference: G.O.Ms. No. 168 MA&UD (2012) — lake buffer rules

cmsvbecj0001i7m8orzun5qsi.title: Farm land sold as plots without conversion (NALA)
cmsvbecj0001i7m8orzun5qsi.description: Agricultural land must be converted to non-agricultural use before it is divided into plots. Plots carved out of unconverted farm land face registration and building-permission problems.
cmsvbecj0001i7m8orzun5qsi.checkMethod: Ask for the NALA conversion order and check the land's classification in its Bhu Bharati record; a layout should also carry an HMDA or DTCP layout permission (LP) number.
cmsvbecj0001i7m8orzun5qsi.govReference: Telangana Agricultural Land (Conversion for Non-Agricultural Purposes) Act, 2006

cmsvbecj1001j7m8ocu9bdtmt.title: Pending mutation, succession or partition
cmsvbecj1001j7m8ocu9bdtmt.description: If the seller's title has a pending mutation, an unresolved succession or a partition claim, your registration can be stuck or challenged.
cmsvbecj1001j7m8ocu9bdtmt.checkMethod: Check the record of rights for the survey number on Bhu Bharati, and get an Encumbrance Certificate for at least 30 years from the Registration department.
cmsvbecj1001j7m8ocu9bdtmt.govReference: Telangana Bhu Bharati (Record of Rights in Land) Act, 2025

cmsvbecj2001k7m8o73nrryx8.title: Projects that should be RERA-registered but aren't
cmsvbecj2001k7m8o73nrryx8.description: Projects over 500 sq.m of land or more than 8 units must register with TG-RERA before advertising or selling. Splitting a project into small phases to avoid registration removes your RERA protections.
cmsvbecj2001k7m8o73nrryx8.checkMethod: Search the project and promoter on the TG-RERA portal. If it isn't there, ask the developer why, and check the total land and unit count against the layout plan.
cmsvbecj2001k7m8o73nrryx8.govReference: Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016 — Section 3

cmsvbecj3001l7m8o7yk02o62.title: Which authority approved the layout (HMDA or DTCP)
cmsvbecj3001l7m8o7yk02o62.description: Layouts inside the Hyderabad Metropolitan Region are approved by HMDA; outside it, by DTCP. An LP number from the wrong authority, or none, is a red flag.
cmsvbecj3001l7m8o7yk02o62.checkMethod: Note the layout permission (LP) number and verify it with the authority named on it (HMDA or DTCP).
cmsvbecj3001l7m8o7yk02o62.govReference: HMDA Act, 2008; Telangana Town Planning Act

cmsvbecj4001m7m8org50n9ke.title: Undivided share of land (UDS) in apartments
cmsvbecj4001m7m8org50n9ke.description: Each flat comes with an undivided share of the land. If the shares sold add up to more than the land, owners lose out at redevelopment or in a dispute.
cmsvbecj4001m7m8org50n9ke.checkMethod: Check the UDS in your sale agreement and the project's TG-RERA filing: the shares of all units together should equal the project's land area.
cmsvbecj4001m7m8org50n9ke.govReference: TG-RERA project disclosures; registered sale deed
